claims.object_text: interneuron development defects after conditional disruption
claims.quote: conditional disruption of Foxg1 in the subpallium results in defects in interneuron development.

claims.object_text: roundabout-1, Eph receptor A4, and C-X-C motif receptor 4/7 downregulated
claims.quote: In developing interneurons, the expression levels of several receptors, including roundabout-1, Eph receptor A4, and C-X-C motif receptor 4/7, were strongly downregulated
which led to migration defects after Foxg1 ablation.

claims.object_text: Dlx1/2 and Mash1 upregulated at the mRNA level
claims.quote: The transcription factors Dlx1/2 and Mash1, which have been reported to be involved in interneuron development, were significantly upregulated at the mRNA levels.

claims.object_text: shorter neurites and fewer branches in Foxg1 mutant cells
claims.quote: Foxg1 mutant cells developed shorter neurites and fewer branches
Foxg1 mutant cells developed shorter neurites and fewer branches and displayed severe migration defects in vitro.

claims.object_text: Prox1 dramatically upregulated at mRNA and protein levels
claims.quote: Notably, Prox1, which is a transcription factor that functions as a key regulator in the development of excitatory neurons, was also dramatically upregulated at both the mRNA and protein levels,

claims.object_text: upstream regulator of Dlx1/2, Mash1, and Prox1 to control interneuron development
claims.quote: Our work demonstrates that Foxg1 may act as a critical upstream regulator of Dlx1/2, Mash1, and Prox1 to control interneuron development.
